meta.parties: In Re Duncan Anderson & Co. (In Liquidation) Ex.Parte, Bishop Et Al

rules.statement: The Colombo firm was a branch of the London partnership, and the London liquidator has priority over the Ceylon deed of arrangement.
rules.supporting_quote: "With respect to the first point, we are of opinion that it has been clearly established that the Colombo firm was only a branch of the London house of John Anderson & Co. The partners in both were the same, the business of the same nature, the capital one, and the ratio of profits of the partners in either place the same."
